**M2 — must-fix — Open item 1 hands to #27191 a question the ruling already settles, so the ADR records less than was ruled.** The ruling's D1 text, quoted in the ADR, says the home amount is "STORED with the rate used"; the ruling's design rule 2, quoted in D8, says "no injected columns, no fixed field names — every currency-related field is declared by the app author and referenced by pointer". Read together, the rate used can live only in an author-declared field named by a pointer, so when `homeAmount` is declared its rate pointer is required; and "computed AT WRITE from the document date's rate" plus rule 2 make the document-date pointer required too (no default; the engine cannot guess a document date). Open item 1 nonetheless lists "whether they are required" as open and says "#27191 reconciles the two". As written, a contract review of #27191 reading this ADR could accept the workload's `rateField?` (optional), which leaves a write where the rate used is stored nowhere — a breach of D1 that the ADR, not the ruling, made possible. Fix: Open item 1 keeps only the **spelling** of the two pointers (`rateDate`, `rateField` or other names) as #27191's; it states that both pointers are required by D1 and D8 rule 2 whenever `homeAmount` is declared, and that workload row M2-1's and #27191's optional `rateField` is corrected to required. The ADR's own authority clause ("the ruling's own text is the authority … where the two differ, the ruling wins") supports exactly this.

**S1 — should-fix — the ADR-0104 note overlaps PR #27233's note at the same insertion point and duplicates #27182's deliverable.** #27233 (Fixes #27182, open, `mergeable_state: clean`) rewrites the paragraph's own sentence ("deleted (registered in `RETIRED_DEFS_BY_MAJOR` …)") and inserts its own `> **Note (2026-10-28, #27182, PR #27233) — CurrencyValueSchema is deleted.**` directly after L172 — the line this PR's note also follows. Whichever lands second conflicts in a Tier H file, and the moment #27233 lands this note's "First, the deletion it records has not happened yet" reads false beside a note saying it has. #27182's card task assigns the deletion note to #27182, not to this ADR. Fix: keep only the second sentence group (multi-currency keeps D1; the record's currency lives in a sibling ISO 4217 field named through `currencyField`, never in the value) and point to #27182 for the retirement's own note; drop "needs two corrections" (the second is a confirmation, not a correction).

**S2 — should-fix — a continuation anchor is silently unverified.** In the ADR-0104 note the span `` `#CurrencyValue` `` sits on the line after `` `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts#CurrencyValueSchema` ``. `scripts/symbol-anchors.mjs` resolves a continuation only from a prior anchor **on the same line** (`CONTINUATION_SPAN` loop, `prior = … before.matchAll(ANCHOR_SPAN) … if (!prior) continue;`), so this citation is skipped, not checked — the gate is green without reading it. Keep the continuation on the path anchor's line (ADR-0144's own instance at "its type `#CurrencyValue`" is on one line and resolves).

**S3 — should-fix — "Builds on … ADR-0112 (the codes and envelope of every refusal this record names)" overstates ADR-0112's reach.** ADR-0112 governs the wire vocabulary (SCREAMING_SNAKE codes on the wire, the standard catalog plus the extension ledger). The build-time refusals this ADR names (a `currencyField` target that is not a domain text field; an ungrouped raw aggregate refused at build) are authoring diagnostics, not wire errors. Scope the citation to the runtime refusals (`ERR_CURRENCY_CODE_REQUIRED`, `ERR_EXCHANGE_RATE_MISSING`, Open item 9) and note that any new code is registered in the ADR-0112 extension ledger.

**S4 — should-fix — `sys_exchange_rate` ownership has governing text the ADR does not cite.** ADR-0029 D1/D3/D6 (a first-party capability owns its `sys_*` objects; `platform-objects` is being decomposed) and ADR-0028 (reserved `sys` namespace) govern where a new `sys_*` object may live. Workload row M1-1 and the epic's territory put it in `packages/platform-objects/src`, in tension with ADR-0029 D6. The ADR's D3 rightly names no package; it should cite ADR-0028/ADR-0029 under Builds on and name the owner as #27185's to settle against them, so that card's review has the rule in front of it.

**S5 — should-fix — TL;DR wording.** "It stores the result in a declared home field (`homeAmount`)" conflates the declaration key with the field it points at; D5 has it right (`homeAmount` is the declaration, `homeAmount.field` the stored field). Align the TL;DR.

**S6 — should-fix — Consequences name two `Metadata-protocol: added` cards; there are three.** #27187 (M0-3) also declares `Metadata-protocol: added` for the analytics wire key. Say "the two cards that add authorable keys (#27184, #27191) and the seam card that adds the wire key (#27187)".

**S7 — should-fix — D8 rule 4's "the server never fills in the code" is the record's reading.** The ruling says "the form pre-fills the organization's currency at the renderer, the stored value is always explicit". The ADR's gloss is consistent with it and with M0-2's blank-code refusal, but it sits in the Decision section introduced by "Read plainly". Mark it as the record's reading and cite #27186's `ERR_CURRENCY_CODE_REQUIRED` as the enforcement that makes it true.

**S8 — should-fix — nuance on "no write-side predicate hook".** `providesConfidentiality` (#8026) is a write-path predicate in `service-settings`; the exact sentence is "no write-side guard that can refuse a value change on engine state", which is what M1-3 needs.

**Not findings (checked and clear):** number 0144; status line and date; the two-numberings paragraph (#27119 Q1/Q2 vs sub-questions Q0–Q4) is accurate to `6464202770`/`6465431966`; D7's ÷ arithmetic and the #27192 check; the R1/R2/R3 card map against the epic body; the three PM-placed cards named as the PM's; parameter 1 confined to backfill/recompute; Open items 2–10 are each genuinely undecided by the ruling and correctly sourced; verification-notes commands print what the comments say at `d745bb5e`.
